solutions.vnSme.faq.title: Frequently asked
solutions.vnSme.faq.q1: Where is my data stored — Australia or Vietnam?
solutions.vnSme.faq.a1: Primary storage is in Sydney (AWS ap-southeast-2). We do not store personal data in Vietnam. VN-language evidence is stored encrypted alongside your other evidence; a Vietnamese-language render is generated on-demand, not cached, unless you export it.
solutions.vnSme.faq.q2: Do Vietnamese-language reports meet Australian investor expectations?
solutions.vnSme.faq.a2: Trust Reports render in the reader's language. Australian investors reading a VN-SME profile see the executive summary and audited findings in English; the underlying evidence retains its original language with a translation footnote. Vietnamese counterparts get the VI mirror. Same verification level, same audit trail.
solutions.vnSme.faq.q3: What's the refund policy on the A$5.50 Trust Report?
solutions.vnSme.faq.a3: If a report fails to generate for any technical reason, we refund automatically to your original Stripe payment method. Successful generations are non-refundable because the audited output is delivered instantly. Accidental-purchase refunds within 14 days are honoured under Australian Consumer Law.
solutions.vnSme.disclaimer: Not financial or legal advice. Cross-border evidence remains subject to the receiving jurisdiction's rules. Auschain PTY LTD · ACN 659 615 111 · ABN 79 659 615 111 · Sydney NSW.
